messages:
oncall-bot: Pager triggered for service=canary-health-checker region=eu-west-1 severity=P2 — alert: sustained 5xx spike in canary pool over 5m. Runbook: /runbooks/canary-health. Paging eng-oncall.

sara: i'm on pager. Datadog shows canary 5xx rate ~12% (5m) and latency jumps on /generate-stream.

mike: grabbing logs from affected pods, getting a lot of upstream 503s from auth-proxy. error pattern: `200->503` on internal auth call.

ana: we started rollout v2.3.1 (canary 10%) ~8m ago. tagging: model-serving changes + fastpath routing. Could be routing mismatch.

ana: @sara any customer calls yet?

sara: small number of failing requests visible in SLO dashboard — ~14 distinct customer tokens in last 10m. No large-scale user-visible outage but error budget pressure for streaming endpoints.

mike: i'm SSHing into canary nodes now. Stack traces show a new NPE in kv-cache init when auth header absent. seems correlated with fastpath enabled.

ana: if it's the fastpath flag, we can flip fastpath.v2 -> false before doing a full rollback. toggling flag is much faster and lower-risk than killing deployment.

kevin: we should follow abort criteria from the rollout plan: abort if canary 5xx > 10% for 5m OR request latency p50 > 2s. Criteria met. recommend immediate stop and fallback.

sara: Agreed. Quick plan: 1) toggle feature flag off, 2) pause canary rollout, 3) if errors persist, scale down canary replicas and route traffic to stable. I'll run the flag toggle now.

sara: Running flag toggle — command:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://flags.internal/api/v1/toggle 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_API_TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"name":"fastpath.v2","enabled":false}'
```

oncall-bot: Action recorded: feature flag fastpath.v2 set to false by sara at 1738502523.

mike: Confirmed: new requests to canary now go through stable path. Error spikes dropping in logs (observed reduction in auth-proxy 503s).

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused by pipeline (release id: rel-2024-1097). Traffic shift: 100% -> stable.

ops-bot: Executed routing change: canary traffic routed back to stable in eu-west-1.

ana: Good. i'm seeing 5xx down to ~1.5% in the last 2m. Customer impact limited but non-zero.

kevin: do we want to scale down canary replicas to 0 to be safe? Could avoid any lingering session-state issues.

sara: i'm going to scale canary to 0 now as a precaution. kubectl command I will run:
```bash
kubectl -n production scale deployment canary-model-v2 --replicas=0
```

oncall-bot: Scale command issued by sara at 1738502641. Replica count -> 0.

mike: pods terminating cleanly, load back to stable nodes. No more new 503s.

ana: Opening a short incident: canary rollout caused auth-proxy mismatch when fastpath.v2 is enabled; mitigation = feature flag off + pause + scale-to-zero. Need postmortem to include: why fastpath wasn't covered by integration test, whether rollout policy should start at 1% not 10%.

kevin: assigning PM/owner: @ana (postmortem). Ana can you own timeline + remediation?

ana: i’ll own the postmortem. will include repro steps & checklist for future canaries.

sara: Customer impact summary for incident channel: ~14 tokens affected, multiple 5xx on /generate-stream between 1738502468-1738502620, mitigated by 1738502641. No SLA breaches detected yet, but monitor for escalations.

mike: thumbs up on remediation. Also suggest adding a canary-probe that exercises auth-proxy path explicitly.

kevin: added follow-up: reduce initial canary % to 1% for model-serving changes; enable auth-proxy smoke test in canary pipeline.

ops-bot: Handoff note — on-call shifts to night team in 45m. Current oncall (sara) to handoff after final checks.

sara: i'll run a 30m watch, then hand off to @kevin for overnight monitoring. leaving notes in incident doc: /incidents/canary-1738502468. :white_check_mark:

ana: thanks team. will draft postmortem and ETA ~ EOD.

kevin: ack, will pick up handoff. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
